about: dlee as the server's own account, personal mode

content.text: Acting as "dlee" (oid 10000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1), personal mode. There is no per-caller identity: midPoint sees this server's configured credentials, whoever is driving the MCP client, and every self-scoped tool answers for that account. This identity is linked to no orgs, so list_my_team / list_my_managers can only be empty.
